comment.text: FAT1 R1627 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Bowel tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: esophagusstomach; Head and neck tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: headandneck; Pancreatic tumors. report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting FAT1 residue R1627 have been observed in uterine tumors, head and neck tumors, and bowel tumors. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
